$comment: Machine-readable dated compliance obligations for the Council of AI attestation engine. Dates re-verify against official texts before external use. status: one of 'not-started' | 'in-progress' | 'done' | 'monitoring'.

obligations.name: EU AI Act — GPAI enforcement powers live
obligations.obligation: AI Office may request documentation, run/require evaluations, and restrict or withdraw GPAI models. Fines up to EUR 15,000,000 or 3% of total worldwide annual turnover, whichever is higher.
obligations.our_action: Populate compliance/eu-ai-act-gpai.md model-map with real models; ensure every model-calling component has a portability fallback; confirm deployer-vs-provider classification.

obligations.name: CRA — notified-body / conformity-assessment provisions apply
obligations.obligation: Conformity-assessment framework and notified-body provisions in force; relevant if the engine is classified important/critical.
obligations.our_action: Confirm which distribution modes (white-label/licensed) cross the CRA 'manufacturer placing a product on the market' threshold.

obligations.name: CRA — vulnerability & incident reporting to ENISA applies
obligations.obligation: 24h early warning / 72h notification / 14-day final report to ENISA (and national CSIRT) for actively exploited vulnerabilities and severe incidents.
obligations.our_action: Stand up the ENISA reporting runbook: assign roles, register ENISA platform access, generate+sign SBOM, add SCA gate to CI, create incident register. Operational by 2026-09-11.

obligations.name: CRA — full conformity obligations apply
obligations.obligation: Full essential cybersecurity requirements, CE marking, and technical-documentation obligations in force.
obligations.our_action: Complete conformity assessment path for the shipped product; maintain signed SBOM + documentation.

obligations.name: xrpl.js supply-chain hygiene (CVE-2025-32965)
obligations.obligation: Compromised xrpl versions 4.2.1-4.2.4 and 2.14.2; fixed in 4.2.5/2.14.3; current stable 5.x. Already patched upstream.
obligations.our_action: When XRPL publisher stage is wired, pin xrpl >= 4.2.5 (prefer 5.x); verify resolved version; add SCA gate; use least-privilege npm tokens (npm 2FA/token changes ~Aug 2026, direct publish ~Jan 2027).

obligations.name: npm 2FA / granular token tightening
obligations.obligation: npm tightening of 2FA-on-publish and granular access token lifetimes (approximate date, verify against npm changelog).
obligations.our_action: Audit CI npm tokens; rotate to short-lived granular tokens; enable 2FA-on-publish.

obligations.name: npm move toward direct/trusted publishing
obligations.obligation: Shift toward trusted/direct publishing reducing reliance on long-lived tokens (approximate date, verify against npm changelog).
obligations.our_action: If we publish any package, plan trusted/OIDC publishing from CI rather than stored tokens.
